messages:
mira: Noticing spike: some customers getting charged twice on reconnects during streaming. Quick thread.
leo: Details?
mira: Repro: mobile SDK drops net, reconnects without session_id, router treats as new req -> ratecheck re-applies prefix charge. Logs: `charge_evt user=acct42 route=eu tokens=+24` then same again on resume.
asha: Are toolcalls involved?
mira: Yes in a few traces. If toolcall started pre-hiccup we sometimes bill toolcall cost twice plus resumed tokens.
leo: Proposed short term: mark resume events as provisional in billing events and surface on Console so CS can refund quickly.
mira: Long term: router should consult resume metadata. If client sends prefix_hash and connect_id within short window, dedupe charge. Pseudocode:
```
// resume handling
if (hdr.session_id) { check session.last_billed_prefix }
else if (hdr.connect_id && recent(prefix_hash, connect_id)) { dedupe }
else mark_provisional()
```
asha: That logic avoids extra KV RTTs if we can use connect_id heuristic. But it's probabilistic.
ops-bot: NOTE: create incident if duplicate charge rate > 0.1% for any org.
billing-bot: Rule created: billing:reconnect_provisional_alert (threshold=0.1%).
leo: Console work: add a per-session filter `provisional=true`, and a column `provisional_tokens`. Also add an action "flag for refund" that creates a billing ticket.
mira: Also, quotas must not count provisional tokens toward hard limits. Otherwise customers hit quota unexpectedly.
asha: Agree. Implementation: increment `quota.locked_provisional` but only apply to enforcement when confirmed. Reconciliation job later converts provisional to confirmed and updates quota.
leo: Tests: unit router tests for resume dedupe, integration with billing pipeline to ensure provisional flow, and e2e with mobile SDK simulator.
mira: Rollout plan: behind feature flag per-route, canary 5% then 25. SDK owners will add connect_id soon.
asha: For toolcalls: persist `toolcall_trace_id` in session metadata as soon as toolcall triggered so resume can check billed state.
leo: I'll open ENG-5023 with design and PR checklist. Assignments: mira -> console prototype, asha -> router POC, leo -> billing rules and tests.
mira: adding sample trace IDs to the ticket. Thanks.
